```{python}
#| fig-width: 2
#| fig-height: 2

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import pandas as pd

# Load the datasets
merged_data = pd.read_csv("data/merged_data.csv")

merged_data.head()

```

```{python}

# Professional, elegant color palette (vibrant but slightly muted)
refined_palette = {
    "Very Low": "#3b8ea5",     # rich teal blue
    "Low": "#7ec4cf",          # soft muted aqua
    "Moderate": "#f4d35e",     # sophisticated yellow-gold
    "High": "#ee964b",         # warm muted orange
    "Very High": "#d1495b"     # elegant deep red
}
# Prettify category names
category_labels = {
    "national_failures": "National Failures",
    "weak_systems": "Weak Systems",
    "making_progress": "Making Progress",
    "missing_key_laws": "Missing Key Laws",
    "national_leader": "National Leader"
}

# Vibrant, exciting palette (high-contrast but tasteful)
vibrant_palette = {
    "national_failures": "#d73027",  # vivid red
    "weak_systems": "#fc8d59",       # bright coral
    "making_progress": "#fee08b",    # golden yellow
    "missing_key_laws": "#91bfdb",   # light vibrant blue
    "national_leader": "#4575b4"     # deep vivid blue
}

# Ensure order
merged_data['gun_law_strength'] = pd.Categorical(
    merged_data['gun_law_strength'], 
    categories=["national_failures", "weak_systems", "making_progress", "missing_key_laws", "national_leader"],
    ordered=True
)

plt.figure(figsize=(11, 6))
sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid")

ax = sns.boxplot(
    x="gun_law_strength",
    y="firearm_mortality_by_state_2022",
    data=merged_data,
    order=["national_failures", "weak_systems", "making_progress", "missing_key_laws", "national_leader"],
    palette=vibrant_palette,
    linewidth=1.8,
    fliersize=3,
    boxprops=dict(alpha=0.9, linewidth=1.5),
    whiskerprops=dict(linewidth=1.4),
    capprops=dict(linewidth=1.4),
    medianprops=dict(color="black", linewidth=2)
)

# Update the tick labels to proper format without rotation
ax.set_xticklabels([category_labels[label.get_text()] for label in ax.get_xticklabels()], fontsize=13)

# Labeling
plt.xlabel("Gun Law Strength Category", fontsize=15, labelpad=10)
plt.ylabel("Firearm Mortality Rate (2022)", fontsize=15, labelpad=10)
plt.title("Firearm Mortality Rates by Gun Law Strength", fontsize=20, weight='bold', pad=20)

# Subtle gridlines
plt.grid(axis="y", linestyle="--", alpha=0.25)

# Add median annotations on each box
medians = merged_data.groupby("gun_law_strength")["firearm_mortality_by_state_2022"].median()
for i, median in enumerate(medians):
    ax.text(i, median + 0.5, f"{median:.1f}", ha='center', fontsize=11, weight='bold', color="black")

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

```

```{python}
# Define bins and categories (if not already done)
bins = [0, 10, 15, 20, 25, merged_data['firearm_mortality_by_state_2022'].max()]
labels = ["Very Low", "Low", "Moderate", "High", "Very High"]
merged_data['mortality_category'] = pd.cut(
    merged_data['firearm_mortality_by_state_2022'], bins=bins, labels=labels
)

# Vibrant eye-catching palette (progressing from cool green to deep red-purple)
vibrant_mortality_palette = {
    "Very Low": "#2a9d8f",     # teal
    "Low": "#8ecae6",          # soft sky blue
    "Moderate": "#f9c74f",     # vivid yellow
    "High": "#f9844a",         # vibrant orange
    "Very High": "#d00000"     # deep red
}

plt.figure(figsize=(11, 6))
sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid")

ax = sns.boxplot(
    data=merged_data, 
    x='mortality_category', 
    y='drug_overdose_mortality_rate', 
    palette=vibrant_mortality_palette,
    linewidth=1.8,
    fliersize=3,
    boxprops=dict(alpha=0.9, linewidth=1.5),
    whiskerprops=dict(linewidth=1.4),
    capprops=dict(linewidth=1.4),
    medianprops=dict(color="black", linewidth=2)
)

# Clean and larger axis labels with no rotation
ax.set_xticklabels([label for label in labels], fontsize=13)
plt.xlabel("Firearm Mortality Category", fontsize=15, labelpad=10)
plt.ylabel("Drug Overdose Mortality Rate (per 100,000)", fontsize=15, labelpad=10)
plt.title("Drug Overdose Mortality Rate by Firearm Mortality Category", fontsize=20, weight='bold', pad=20)

# Light grid lines for clarity
plt.grid(axis='y', linestyle='--', alpha=0.25)

# Add median annotations
medians = merged_data.groupby('mortality_category')['drug_overdose_mortality_rate'].median()
for i, median in enumerate(medians):
    ax.text(i, median + 0.5, f"{median:.1f}", ha='center', fontsize=11, weight='bold', color="black")

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))

ax = sns.boxplot(
    data=merged_data, 
    x='mortality_category', 
    y='gini_index', 
    palette=refined_palette,
    width=0.5,
    linewidth=1.5,
    fliersize=2.5,
    boxprops=dict(alpha=0.9, linewidth=1.4),
    whiskerprops=dict(linewidth=1.3),
    capprops=dict(linewidth=1.3),
    medianprops=dict(color="black", linewidth=2)
)

ax.set_xticklabels([label for label in labels], fontsize=14)

plt.title("Income Inequality (Gini Index) by Firearm Mortality Category", fontsize=22, weight='bold', pad=22)
plt.xlabel("Firearm Mortality Category", fontsize=16, labelpad=12)
plt.ylabel("Gini Index (Higher = More Inequality)", weight='bold', fontsize=16, labelpad=12)

plt.grid(axis='y', linestyle="--", linewidth=0.7, alpha=0.25)

medians = merged_data.groupby('mortality_category')['gini_index'].median()
for i, median in enumerate(medians):
    ax.text(i, median + 0.005, f"{median:.3f}", ha='center', fontsize=11, weight='bold', color="black")

sns.despine()
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

```{python}

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

palette = {
    "Very Low": "#1c7416", 
    "Low": "#68bb59", 
    "Moderate": "#fab733", 
    "High": "#ff0000", 
    "Very High": "#c61a09"
}

plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.histplot(
    data=merged_data, 
    x="prohibition_for_stalkers", 
    hue="mortality_category", 
    multiple="fill", 
    shrink=0.8, 
    palette=palette
)

plt.title("Firearm Mortality Rates by Prohibition for Stalkers Policy", fontsize=14)
plt.xlabel("Prohibition for Stalkers Policy", fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel("Proportion", fontsize=12)
plt.xticks(fontsize=10)
plt.yticks(fontsize=10)
plt.legend(title="Firearm Mortality Level", fontsize=10)
plt.grid(axis='y', linestyle='--', alpha=0.7)
plt.show()

```

```{python}
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from matplotlib.patches import Patch

# Plot setup
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
ax = sns.histplot(
    data=merged_data, 
    x="asault_weapons_prohibited", 
    hue="mortality_category", 
    multiple="fill", 
    element="bars",
    palette=custom_mortality_palette,
    edgecolor="white",
    binwidth=1,            # full-width bar per category
    binrange=(0, 2),       # ensures bars are centered at 0 and 1
    shrink=0.9             # slight shrink for spacing
)

# Titles and axis labels
plt.title("Firearm Mortality Rates by Assault Weapons Prohibition Policy", fontsize=16, weight='bold')
plt.xlabel("")  # Remove label text
plt.ylabel("Proportion of States", fontsize=13)

# Custom tick labels centered under bars
ax.set_xticks([0, 1])
ax.set_xticklabels(["No", "Yes"], fontsize=12)

# Y ticks
plt.yticks(fontsize=11)
plt.grid(axis='y', linestyle='--', alpha=0.5)

# Custom legend
legend_elements = [
    Patch(facecolor="#68bb59", label="Very Low"),
    Patch(facecolor="#acdf87", label="Low"),
    Patch(facecolor="#fab733", label="Moderate"),
    Patch(facecolor="#ff6242", label="High"),
    Patch(facecolor="#c61a09", label="Very High"),
]
plt.legend(
    handles=legend_elements,
    title="Firearm Mortality Level",
    title_fontsize=12,
    fontsize=11,
    loc="upper center",
    bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, -0.15),
    ncol=3,
    frameon=False
)

# Adjust spacing
plt.tight_layout()
plt.subplots_adjust(bottom=0.2)
plt.show()

```
